_meta.инвокация: docker exec agelto_postgres psql -U agelto -d agelto <команда метрики>
_meta.формат значений: сырой вывод psql -At (строки разделены \n, колонки — |), без пересказа
_meta.точки: t0 — до старта прогона A; t1 — середина прогона B (ценовое дробление); t2 — после остановки прогона B

не снято.bloat % (строгий): pgstattuple не установлено (select count(*) from pg_extension where extname='pgstattuple' → 0)
не снято.per-query write pressure / contention: pg_stat_statements не установлено, требует shared_preload_libraries и рестарта кластера (P7.4)
не снято.replica lag: реплики нет, на одиночном primary не измеряется

команды.M-1_table_sizes: psql -At -c "select relname, pg_total_relation_size(relid), pg_relation_size(relid), pg_indexes_size(relid) from pg_stat_user_tables where relname like 'prc_%' order by 1;"
команды.M-2_tuples_autovacuum: psql -At -c "select relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, n_mod_since_analyze, last_autovacuum, last_autoanalyze, autovacuum_count from pg_stat_user_tables where relname like 'prc_%' order by 1;"
команды.M-3_wal_lsn: t0: psql -At -c "select pg_current_wal_lsn(), clock_timestamp();" | t1/t2: psql -At -c "select pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), '<lsn_t0>'), clock_timestamp();"
команды.M-4_wal_counters: psql -At -c "select wal_records, wal_fpi, wal_bytes, stats_reset from pg_stat_wal;"
команды.M-5_wait_events: psql -At -c "select wait_event_type, wait_event, count(*) from pg_stat_activity where backend_type='client backend' group by 1,2;"
команды.M-6_index_usage: psql -At -c "select relname, indexrelname, idx_scan, pg_relation_size(indexrelid) from pg_stat_user_indexes where relname like 'prc_%' order by idx_scan;"
команды.M-6_stats_reset: psql -At -c "select stats_reset from pg_stat_database where datname='agelto';"
команды.M-7_app_counters: psql -At -c "select (select count(*) from prc_procurements), (select count(*) from prc_revisions), (select count(*) from prc_events), (select count(*) from prc_fetches), (select count(*) from prc_fetches where proxy_id is null), (select count(*) from prc_documents);"
команды.M-8_fetch_profile: psql -At -c "select count(*), avg(duration_ms)::int, max(duration_ms), sum(rows_total), sum(rows_new), sum(rows_updated) from prc_fetches;"
команды.M-9_scan_gap: psql -At -c "select id, stats->>'scan_gap_seconds', stats->>'oldest_update_seen' from prc_crawler_runs order by id desc limit 10;"
